resolved.1_exchange_recover: kiln-lattice-dispatch's workflow-exchange route now decides recovery with exchange_recovery before any write (before the request seal, the owner-grant gate and begin_dispatch_transport): --recover is refused with 'recovery requires prior persisted transport intent' unless dispatch_requires_recovery is already true, mirroring the worker route. A persisted start still drives recovery with or without the flag, and a fresh attempt always passes the owner-grant gate. Test (bin unit test): --recover without a prior start is refused; with a prior start (in-band crash) recovery proceeds; no flag and no start goes through the gate.

2_claim_gate.choice: Preferred: enforced at the shared claim point.
2_claim_gate.rule: Implementer::claim_next_deferred (the library claim used by claim_next, kiln-fleet and other embedders; the only production AttemptLedger::claim caller outside the admission Claim/ClaimExact step) reads the admission ledger in the same immediate transaction as the claim. When fair_admission::host_owner_governed holds (a configured policy with a domain-tagged host-owner campaign root account) it refuses with host_owner_admission_required before claiming; the expiry it performed rolls back with the refused transaction.
2_claim_gate.coverage: Coverage is decided per store, not per repository: the admission ledger does not retain the registration's repository list, and queue rows exist only for already-admitted work, so a per-repository check would miss covered work not yet queued. A host-owner root therefore governs every claim in that store; the operator claim command and campaign claims already route through admission under any policy.
2_claim_gate.why_race_free: Policy and accounts are read inside the same SQLite immediate transaction that writes the attempt, so no policy or root committed concurrently can be missed.
2_claim_gate.unchanged: Without a host-owner root (no policy, or a policy whose accounts are not host-owner roots) every claim path is unchanged apart from one read of the admission state.
2_claim_gate.tests: unbound claim refused under a host-owner policy with no attempt created (including unregistered work); allowed under a policy without a host-owner root; the admission claim still succeeds and binds the transport start.
